nodes.label: Auditoria profunda — Sprint 20 (2026-07-09)
nodes.rationale: Three parallel audits (API security, business logic/Prisma, UX/frontend consistency) run over commit 4274165a; 13 of 16 findings were fixed the same sprint under an explicit 'high impact + low risk first' triage rule, with the remaining 3 (Redis rate-limit migration, PageHeader unification, explicit onDelete) deliberately deferred as higher-surface schema-touching work.

nodes.label: IDOR sin filtro de zona en score/relaciones de incidencias
nodes.rationale: hospitales/[id]/score and score?ids= batch (up to 50 IDs) leaked health-score breakdowns of hospitals outside a non-ADMIN user's zone, and incidencias/[id]/relaciones GET+POST allowed reading/linking incidents across zones — fixed with the same zone-filter pattern already used elsewhere in the incidencias API.

nodes.label: checkRateLimit/checkRateLimitByKey migrated to real Redis (async)
nodes.rationale: Prior implementation never actually called Redis despite Upstash being configured — always fell back to in-memory. Converted to async using redisIncrement (Redis when getRedis() available, in-memory fallback otherwise), with ~150 call-sites across 85 files in src/app/api plus src/lib/auth.ts updated to await; the now-redundant checkRateLimitByKeyAsync was deleted as dead code.

nodes.label: $transaction Serializable added to relaciones POST + SLA-pause PATCH
nodes.rationale: Duplicate-check-then-create in incidencias/[id]/relaciones POST and read-calculate-update in the SLA pause logic of incidencias/[id] PATCH were both vulnerable to race conditions/lost updates without atomicity; wrapped in db.$transaction with isolationLevel: Serializable.

nodes.label: PageHeader migrated into 12 additional pages
nodes.rationale: PageHeader was only used in 11 of ~30 pages before this fix; extended with optional icon/iconColor props to avoid losing icon badges some pages already had. Deliberate exceptions kept: mapa and incidencias/stats (need full-width toolbar, same pattern as presentation mode), perfil (identity card, not a listing), [id] detail pages (own breadcrumb headers), and the deactivated ventas/pipeline CRM module.

nodes.label: Hardcoded TEAL/ORANGE hex consolidated into brand.ts imports
nodes.rationale: TabResumen.tsx PDF template (~17 occurrences), 11 error.tsx files, and admin/zonas/page.tsx all hardcoded brand hex instead of importing from brand.ts; also consolidated a duplicated tipo→color mapping between CommandPalette.tsx and TopBar.tsx into a single TIPO_RESULTADO_COLOR export in brand.ts.
